title: Replace the SQLite pager cache-miss ratio assertions in the capped settlement-detail read test with a behavioural check
outcome: capped_settlement_detail_read_skips_oversized_payload_pages proves that an oversized settlement value is not fetched through observable behaviour, not through fixed thresholds on SQLite's internal pager counters, so a bundled SQLite or configuration change cannot fail it while the product is unchanged.
acceptance: The test no longer asserts on SQLITE_DBSTATUS_CACHE_MISS ratios or uses the unsafe sqlite3_db_status FFI call.

It still proves that an oversized settlement value is skipped without fetching its text: for example the capped detail query returns no text for a value above the bound, admissionDetailsLimited is true, and no admissionChecks are projected.
